rules.name: RobotShopContainerOOMKilled
rules.query: sum by (namespace, service) (label_replace((increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="robot-shop"}[10m]) > 0) and on (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace="robot-shop",reason="OOMKilled"} == 1), "service", "$1", "container", "(.*)"))

annotations.summary: {{ $labels.service }} was stopped for using too much memory

rules.name: RobotShopContainerRestarting
rules.query: sum by (namespace, service) (label_replace((increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="robot-shop"}[10m]) > 1) and on (namespace, pod, container) kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="robot-shop"}, "service", "$1", "container", "(.*)"))

rules.name: RobotShopReplicasUnavailable
rules.query: sum by (namespace, service) (label_replace(kube_deployment_status_replicas_unavailable{namespace="robot-shop"} > 0, "service", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)")) or sum by (namespace, service) (label_replace((kube_statefulset_replicas{namespace="robot-shop"} - kube_statefulset_status_replicas_ready{namespace="robot-shop"}) > 0, "service", "$1", "statefulset", "(.*)"))

annotations.summary: {{ $labels.service }} has fewer working copies than it should (missing: {{ $value }})

rules.name: RobotShopHTTPErrors
rules.query: label_replace((sum by (namespace, destination_workload) (rate(istio_requests_total{namespace="robot-shop",reporter="destination",response_code=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum by (namespace, destination_workload) (rate(istio_requests_total{namespace="robot-shop",reporter="destination"}[5m])) > 0.05) and on (namespace, destination_workload) (sum by (namespace, destination_workload) (increase(istio_requests_total{namespace="robot-shop",reporter="destination"}[5m])) >= 30), "service", "$1", "destination_workload", "(.*)")

annotations.summary: {{ $labels.service }} answered {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} of its requests with a server error
payment answered 24.96% of its requests with a server error

rules.name: RobotShopShippingSlowRequests
rules.query: (1 - sum by (namespace) (rate(istio_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{destination_workload="shipping",le="2500",namespace="robot-shop",reporter="destination"}[2m])) / sum by (namespace) (rate(istio_request_duration_milliseconds_count{destination_workload="shipping",namespace="robot-shop",reporter="destination"}[2m])) > 0.15) and on (namespace) (sum by (namespace) (increase(istio_request_duration_milliseconds_count{destination_workload="shipping",namespace="robot-shop",reporter="destination"}[2m])) >= 30)

annotations.summary: {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} of shipping cost lookups took longer than 2.5 seconds

rules.name: RobotShopRatingsSlowRequests
rules.query: (1 - sum by (namespace) (rate(istio_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{destination_workload="ratings",le="500",namespace="robot-shop",reporter="destination"}[2m])) / sum by (namespace) (rate(istio_request_duration_milliseconds_count{destination_workload="ratings",namespace="robot-shop",reporter="destination"}[2m])) > 0.1) and on (namespace) (sum by (namespace) (increase(istio_request_duration_milliseconds_count{destination_workload="ratings",namespace="robot-shop",reporter="destination"}[2m])) >= 30)

annotations.summary: {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} of ratings lookups took longer than 0.5 seconds
